# Former Glory

> Raid strategy guides and guild resources for Former Glory on Project Quarm (EverQuest).

Boss pages are raid briefs: mechanics, timers, CH chains, and assignments. They are the citable source for how Former Glory fights these encounters.

## Strategy

- [Strategy index]({{ '/strategy/' | absolute_url }}): Boss guides by expansion, Classic through Planes of Power
- [Planes of Power progression]({{ '/strategy/pop_progression/' | absolute_url }}): Flagging and raid order
- [Plane of Time]({{ '/strategy/plane_of_time/' | absolute_url }}): Phase event guide
- [Quarm]({{ '/strategy/quarm/' | absolute_url }}): Plane of Time phase 6
- [Xegony]({{ '/strategy/xegony/' | absolute_url }}): Plane of Air
- [Fennin Ro]({{ '/strategy/fennin_ro/' | absolute_url }}): Plane of Fire
- [Coirnav]({{ '/strategy/coirnav/' | absolute_url }}): Plane of Water
- [Avatar of Earth]({{ '/strategy/avatar_of_earth/' | absolute_url }}): Plane of Earth
- [Rallos Zek the Warlord]({{ '/strategy/rallos_zek_the_warlord/' | absolute_url }}): Plane of Tactics
- [Lord Mithaniel Marr]({{ '/strategy/lord_mithaniel_marr/' | absolute_url }}): Halls of Honor
